Along the back wall, a full-width built-in shelf unit in white painted wood holds an artful collection of ceramic vases, pitchers, and woven baskets in various shades of sand, terracotta, and warm beige — a densely curated, earthy display. At the ceiling, two drum-shaped forms with warm textured shades are mounted flush, casting a broad warm ambient glow across the ceiling and table. The entire palette is warm neutrals — plaster sand, natural rattan, bleached wood, dried botanicals, and matte ceramics — creating a deeply organic and casual atmosphere.
